name: calc_card_even_card_subsets
statement: (n : ℕ) : ((Finset.univ : Finset (Finset (Fin (n + 1)))).filter (fun s => Even s.card)).card = 2 ^ n
closed: ∀ (n : ℕ), ((Finset.univ : Finset (Finset (Fin (n + 1)))).filter (fun s => Even s.card)).card = 2 ^ n
informal: Exactly half (2ⁿ) of the subsets of an (n+1)-set have even cardinality — involution s ↦ s ∆ {0} flips parity; or ∑ (−1)^|s| = 0 (Finset.sum_powerset_neg_one_pow_card) with total 2^(n+1).
